skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the history and structure of the hospitality industry.
Identify career opportunities and job requirements in the hospitality industry.
Develop personal career strategies and plans.
Analyze trends and future prospects in the hospitality industry.
Understand professional standards for various positions in the hospitality industry.
Apply critical thinking to analyze the relationship between theory and practice in career development.
Demonstrate self-management and responsibility in career development.
Effectively communicate career plans and strategies.
Collaborate effectively in group projects and presentations.
Deliver effective presentations on career development topics.
